note: Add the unified PYTHIA plugin (cloud + CLI + Desktop, one install) through this Devin UI dialog. Values below are exactly what the form is filled with.

ui.description: Devin reads the plugin from the repository each time it runs, so changes there take effect without re-adding it

Repository.hint: Don't include plaintext secrets. Use plugin secret references instead

Subdirectory.hint: Optional. The plugin's root inside the repository
Subdirectory.warning: The value must be the plugin root: the folder containing .devin-plugin/plugin.json. Never enter this file's path (plugins/ORG_REQUIRED_MANIFEST.json) here — this file is a handoff doc, not a plugin root.
